eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Intelligent Networks and Data-driven Intelligent Applications (ICon INDIA 2026) aims to bring together researchers, academicians, industry professionals, and innovators from across the globe to discuss emerging trends in next-generation networks, artificial intelligence, data analytics, and intelligent computing systems. The conference provides a vibrant platform for presenting cutting-edge research, fostering collaborations, and exploring innovative technologies that shape the future of smart connectivity, intelligent decision-making systems, and digital transformation. ICon INDIA encourages interdisciplinary research contributions that integrate wireless communications, computing, signal processing, machine learning, business analytics, and intelligent infrastructure.
